title: Ukraine live: Russian strikes kill at least 15 in Kyiv and surrounding region
summary: Russian strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed at least 15 people and wounded dozens overnight, authorities said on Wednesday. In recent weeks, both sides have increased long-range attacks, with Russia more than doubling its use of missiles in July.
